description: Bush Fire Prone Area Planning (OBRM-023) is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Fire and Emergency Services. The Bush Fire Prone Area Planning 2025 dataset (OBRM-023) identifies bush fire prone areas of Western Australia as designated by the Fire and Emergency Services (FES) Commissioner on 13 December 2025, with Planning Area 1 and Planning Area 2 attributed. Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Fire and Emergency Services. Its tags are BPA, BPA2024, Bushfire Prone, New BPA 2024, OBRM. It offers 7 resource(s) in api arcgis server map service, fgdb, geojson, geopackage, shp. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
